itemUsage.en: Infected fighter Talulah. She trusts Rhodes Island's ideals and has decided to journey with you.
itemUsage.zh: 感染者战士塔露拉，她信任罗德岛的理想，决定与你同行。

itemDesc.en: You both agree that this is a long-overdue meeting.
itemDesc.zh: 你们都认同这是一场迟到的相遇。

description.en: Gains <$ba.protect>Sanctuary</> with <@ba.vup>{damage_resistance:0%}</> (gradually decreases after lasting for <@ba.vup>{shelter_hold_duration:0.0}</> seconds), deals Talulah's ATK <@ba.vup>{retaliate_atk_scale:0%}</> in AoE Arts damage to the attack source and heals Talulah for HP equal to <@ba.vup>{heal_ratio:0%}</> of the damage dealt; then attacks all blocked enemies for <@ba.vup>{stack_duration:0.0}</> seconds with ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> and DEF <@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</> (stacks up to <@ba.vup>5</> times)\n<@ba.rem>Triggered after taking damage, can store up to {max_stack_cnt:0} charges</>
description.zh: 获得<@ba.vup>{damage_resistance:0%}</>的<$ba.protect>庇护</>（持续<@ba.vup>{shelter_hold_duration:0.0}</>秒后逐渐降低），对攻击来源造成塔露拉攻击力<@ba.vup>{retaliate_atk_scale:0%}</>的范围法术伤害，并治疗塔露拉相当于伤害量<@ba.vup>{heal_ratio:0%}</>的生命值；之后<@ba.vup>{stack_duration:0.0}</>秒内攻击所有阻挡的敌人，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>和防御力<@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</>（可叠加<@ba.vup>5</>层）\n<@ba.rem>受到攻击后触发，可充能{max_stack_cnt:0}次</>

description.en:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>; stops attacking to continuously channel and cause the battlefield to enter the following state: every <@ba.vup>{normal_interval:0.00}</> seconds within a 5-row range, summons "Flame Clusters" facing the deployment direction. When a "Flame Cluster" hits an enemy, it explodes to deal AoE Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>{heatwave_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK. If the target is undergoing a <$ba.dt.burning2>Burn</> burst, deals elemental damage instead
<$ba.overdrive>Overload</>: "Flame Cluster" generation interval shortened to <@ba.vup>{overload_interval:0}</> seconds, range expanded up to 13 rows
When hit by multiple "Flame Clusters" from the same wave, damage dealt by subsequent "Flame Clusters" is reduced to <@ba.vup>{same_wave_repeat_damage_scale:0%}</>
<@ba.rem>This skill can be manually deactivated at any time</>
description.zh:
攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>；停止攻击以持续引导场地进入以下状态：每<@ba.vup>{normal_interval:0.00}</>秒在5行范围内，朝部署方向召唤“簇火”，“簇火”碰到敌人时爆炸造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{heatwave_atk_scale:0%}</>的范围法术伤害；若目标处于<$ba.dt.burning2>灼燃损伤</>爆发期间则改为造成元素伤害
<$ba.overdrive>过载</>：“簇火”生成间隔缩短至<@ba.vup>{overload_interval:0}</>秒，范围扩展最多13行
被同波次的多个“簇火”命中时，后续“簇火”造成的伤害降低至<@ba.vup>{same_wave_repeat_damage_scale:0%}</>
<@ba.rem>该技能可随时主动关闭</>
